currentParagraphText: “That’s my office building,” he said with a smile. “Filled from top to bottom with administrative staff or others working for the Court of Shadows. Most of the training facilities are placed below ground.”

finalResult.nextParagraphText: “I gotta ask... seeing as the Court does assassinations, do you really have a lot of work these days? Like, enough to need that many people working on just administration alone?” Jake asked curiously, wondering if people were hiring hitmen to kill their annoying neighbors left and right.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: Jake wouldn’t be surprised if the city ended up being one of the largest on Earth in the future. It was also a city that was really easy to find from afar, as smack in the middle of the rapidly expanding settlement stood a towering all-black skyscraper, far taller than any of the other buildings around it. In fact, Jake wouldn’t be surprised if it was the largest currently on Earth. Even from afar, Jake could detect powerful magic on it, and Caleb gladly explained what it was.
